content.text: This is a request for a change in account access/permissions (adding access to a shared folder), which requires escalation rather than a KB-based fix.

input.reasoning_summary: Request to grant access to a shared folder due to a team change is an account access/permissions change, not a KB-resolvable issue.

summary.reported: Requester states they moved to the Finance team and needs access to the Finance/Reports shared folder, noting their manager Priya has agreed.
summary.checked: Reviewed the ticket details; this is a request for new folder access rather than a technical fault, so no KB article troubleshooting applies.
summary.ruled_out: Not a technical issue or outage; no KB article covers granting folder permissions.
summary.why_escalating: Granting or changing access to a shared folder is an account permissions change that requires manual verification (e.g., confirming manager approval and correct group/folder) and is outside the scope of KB-based self-service fixes.
